I changed three harness pages and nothing else: `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/receive.md`, `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/understand.md` and `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/analyse.md`. The `asks-which` grader of `gap-erasure-or-deactivation` is a regex over the trace for a `crew decision … add` whose quoted question names erasure, deactivation or anonymisation, and every recorded run of the plugin arm (SP2c, SP7a, this run's three) asked the right question in prose and waited (`waits` and `honest-ending` pass) without ever recording it. The ticket is vague, so the lead asks at Receive step 3, whose text said "ask … and nothing else" and named no record; the Understand bullet names `crew decision <id> add` but left the words to the lead, who asks as soft or hard delete, while the only page holding "Erasure or deactivation" is the deletion checklist, read in Conclave after the wait. Both pages now say that a choice a checklist lists under "Decisions only the user can make" is a decision, never a question, recorded in the checklist's own words before the message asks it, with the "delete" ticket spelled out: recorded with `crew decision <id> add` as the question "Erasure or deactivation: …", default deactivation, never asked as soft or hard delete (written so the page text itself cannot match the regex). For `gap-redirect-target`, the engine routes a `fix` in one spot to the fast route, where the lead reads only SKILL.md (nine bytes under its cap) and, for a fix, `analyse.md`, so the Understand bullet that says to read the routes list never reaches it and one run in three ships the redirect; the Blast radius line of `analyse.md` now says what the fix points at is named with whether it exists after reading where the repository lists them, and that a target no route serves is a decision for the user on every route: wait, say in the message that the target is not a route the app serves, ask whether to add the page or build the redirect anyway, and build
